title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Laboratory Results Panel. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Laboratory Results Panel
options.lineage: clinical pathology reports and veterinary laboratory result forms
options.thesis: The assessment presented as a lab results panel, where every claim is a measured value sitting in a reference range.
options.viewport: A petrol masthead carrying the report as a form header, a left margin rail of panel letters, and the verdict set as a flagged result beside its reference-range band.
options.risk: Reads clinical-cold and procedural, so the commercial argument can feel like a chart rather than advice.

raised.raise: A graduated illumination wash runs down the frame rail, so the depth of the document is visible in the frame itself.
A folded place-mark on the rail records exactly where the reader stopped, and survives a reload.
Figures are set at tabular density with units and ranges aligned, never centred and never decoratively spaced.
The verdict panel carries a hand-set approval stamp, the way a signed form does.

options.label: Decision Memo with Exhibits
options.lineage: strategy consulting decision memos with numbered exhibits and source notes
options.thesis: The report as the crisp board document its authors would actually hand over, with numbered exhibits and a source-note apparatus.
options.viewport: A memo masthead with the verdict boxed at the top, exhibit numbers in the left margin, a two-column exhibit table, and source notes at the foot of the page.
options.risk: Familiar. This is where most runs of this category land, and against a documented, specialised report a reader may find it generic.

options.label: Utility Patent Drawing Sheet
options.thesis: The assessment drawn as an invention to be patented, every exhibit numbered and every caveat marked in the reserved annotation ink.
options.viewport: One bordered bond sheet, Fig. 1 as the verdict drawn as an exploded figure, reference numerals hung on curved leader lines, carmine reserved for what is under examination.
options.case: Fuses cleanly onto the investor reader and gives the unresolved items a reserved colour; loses on clarity, because the core of this report is a threshold, not an object.
options.risk: Reads legalistic and cold for a team making a commercial decision.

options.label: Tension Figure
options.lineage: kinetic tension structures and structural engineering force diagrams
options.thesis: The market shown as a load path, where the gap between what a visit costs and what it can charge is drawn as a visible tension.
options.viewport: A carbon masthead, and beside the verdict the break-even drawn as a strut-and-cord figure with the Rs 850 cost and the Rs 1,100 floor in tension.
options.case: Fuses cleanly onto the economics, which genuinely are a force problem; loses on audience identification, because a structural diagram does not read as advice to a veterinary team.
options.risk: Reads like an engineering drawing and asks the reader to learn a second literacy.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.kept: Environmental commitment in which the frame carries the reader's position rather than a flat page.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a section through a building says nothing about a route-density business.

options.label: Cutting Bench Select Rail
options.lineage: film cutting benches and select rails
options.kept: A physical, unmistakable mark of exactly where the reader stopped.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the film world arrives as a costume on a page meant for reading.

options.label: Data-Sublime Field
options.kept: Uncompromising numerical density and the refusal to soften data.
options.case: Fuses poorly: pure black and white with strobing inversion is anti-read for a 7,000-word decision.

options.label: House Label Sleeve
options.kept: One deliberate human gesture carrying the signature.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a defaced sleeve undercuts the evidence-led tone the report depends on.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
